rationale: The supplied 44/128 translation reads 'war er innen hohl geworden'. Turoyo ḥləd-wa gawa describes the tree's inside becoming hollow; the entry's ihnen incorrectly introduces a plural personal pronoun and hohle has an extra ending.
The existing unnumbered Detransitive Preterit-wa example depicts the tree's interior becoming hollow without an expressed agent. Makes its meaning explicit without duplicating its example.

summary: gawa is the subject of ḥlədwa and identifies the tree's interior. The context describes hollowing as the result of the tree's age, with no expressed external causer.
Preterit-wa presents the resulting cavity as anterior to the surrounding narrative. The Detransitive label is inherited and retained.
No new example, form box or idiom is needed. The active I.1 gloss aushöhlen stays unchanged, while the inherited Detransitive section receives its own explicit sense.
Does this use describe spontaneous decay alone, or can the same Detransitive cover externally caused hollowing? One occurrence cannot decide the wider range.
